adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the refactor now applies pagination to all groups but uses `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` without any maximum. Since the action is reachable for any viewer who can `ensure_can_see!` the group, a client can pass an arbitrarily large `?limit=` value, causing the server to query, load, and JSON-serialize an excessive number of users in one request (`group.users.order(:username_lower).limit(limit)...` and `serialize_data(members, GroupUserSerializer)`). The diff shows no clamping or validation to prevent this.
